clue.text: Arrive earlier, like blood entering head

indicators.note: entering means one piece goes into the other, here the colour into the head

parts.note: pate is an old word for the head
red is the colour of blood

explanation.surface: Someone turns up early, red-faced as though blood had rushed to the head.
explanation.walkthrough: 'like' is a link word joining definition and wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: To predate something is to come before it in time, a synonym for arriving earlier.

clue.text: Bond hit the booze

parts.note: to rap is to strike sharply
port is a fortified wine, a kind of booze

explanation.surface: James Bond knocks back a drink.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bond' looks like the spy, but it means a close connection.
explanation.definitionFit: Rapport is a close bond of understanding between people, a synonym.

clue.text: All fingers and thumbs in Paris — that is, the South

parts.words: All fingers and thumbs in Paris
parts.note: fingers and thumbs together number ten, which is dix in French
i.e. abbreviates id est, that is

explanation.surface: A clumsy visitor in Paris compared with somebody from the American South.
explanation.walkthrough: 'All fingers and thumbs' suggests clumsiness, but it is a count of ten, said in French.
explanation.definitionFit: Dixie is a nickname for the southern states of the USA.

clue.text: Reportedly giant contract

indicators.note: reportedly means the word for giant is heard, not written

parts.note: a titan is a giant

explanation.surface: Word is that a huge contract is on the table.
explanation.walkthrough: 'contract' looks like a noun but is the verb.
explanation.definitionFit: To contract is to draw together and become narrower, a synonym verb.

clue.text: Salt provides great modern art

parts.note: ace means excellent, great
Tate Modern is the London gallery of modern art

explanation.surface: A gallery-goer praises a contemporary exhibition.
explanation.walkthrough: In chemistry a salt is a compound formed from an acid, so 'Salt' is the definition, not table seasoning.
explanation.definitionFit: An acetate is a salt of acetic acid, a chemical example.

clue.text: See 17
Entertainer that's appreciated pranced around

parts.note: ta is British slang for thanks

indicators.note: around tells us the letters of pranced are moved about

explanation.surface: A performer, grateful for applause, prances round the stage.
explanation.walkthrough: TA is a British way of saying thanks, which is why it stands for 'that's appreciated'.
explanation.definitionFit: A dancer performing with metal-soled shoes is a stage entertainer.

clue.text: Advertising vehicle?

parts.note: read as a promotional film preview, or as a wagon towed behind a car

explanation.definitionFit: A film preview advertises the film, and the word also names a towed vehicle.

clue.text: Never licked 23?

parts.note: the answer read as wordplay says the letters of 23 across, the pasta, made rocky (rearranged)

explanation.surface: An undefeated champion, compared with a dish of pasta.
explanation.walkthrough: A reverse clue: ROCKY is an anagram signal and MARCIANO is a rearrangement of MACARONI, the entry at 23.
explanation.definitionFit: The heavyweight boxer retired unbeaten in professional fights, never licked.

clue.text: Top 29 cross

parts.note: the entry at 29 across is an ape type of animal; an ape is one
X is the shape of a cross

explanation.surface: Gorilla at the summit looking angry.
explanation.definitionFit: The apex is the highest point, the top.

clue.text: Floor scheme crushed — not entirely flat surface

parts.note: ground means crushed to powder

indicators.note: not entirely means the last letter of the flat surface word is dropped

parts.note: a plane is a flat surface in geometry

explanation.surface: An architect's design is flattened before it is complete.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not entirely' removes the E of PLANE.
explanation.definitionFit: A ground plan is the layout of a building's floor, a floor scheme.

clue.text: Most inadequate, large ball bearing?

parts.note: L is the clothing-size abbreviation for large
O is round, like a ball
west is a compass bearing

explanation.surface: A big ball bearing is found sadly wanting.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ball bearing' looks like one engineering part, but splits into O and WEST.
explanation.definitionFit: Lowest means least in amount or quality, so poorest or most inadequate.

clue.text: A thousand never 26 — they trying to be clever?

parts.note: K stands for a thousand, as in kilo
no means not at all, never
the entry at 26 is about divisions, and walls divide rooms

explanation.surface: People showing off how clever they are.
explanation.walkthrough: Uses a cross-reference: walls are divisions, linking to the entry at 26.
explanation.definitionFit: Smart alecks who claim expertise in everything are trying to seem clever.

clue.text: Sting, for example, animal, then girl, then me

parts.note: a stag is a male deer, an animal
Ena is a girl's name

explanation.surface: Sting looks like the singer or a wasp, followed by a list of animal, girl and me.
explanation.walkthrough: Sting is the singer Gordon Sumner, whose professional name it is.
explanation.definitionFit: Sting is the performing name of a singer, an example of a professional pseudonym.

clue.text: How long might she be expecting, say, having turned up at Victoria?

definitions.text: How long might she be expecting

indicators.note: in a down clue, turned up means the word is read upwards

parts.note: e.g. means for example, say
Victoria is a major London railway station

explanation.surface: A woman wonders how long the wait will be at Victoria railway station.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turned up' reverses EG to GE. Victoria is a London rail terminus.
explanation.definitionFit: Gestation is the length of pregnancy, how long a mother expects.

clue.text: Painful to grasp a hundred and twenty

indicators.note: to grasp means the painful word holds the Roman hundred

parts.note: sore means painful
C is the Roman numeral for a hundred

explanation.surface: Gripping a hundred and twenty of something hurts.
explanation.walkthrough: 'a hundred and twenty' reads as 120, but 'and' separates wordplay from definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A score is a set of twenty.

clue.text: Promiscuous monk, you say? Don't trust him

parts.note: loose means promiscuous, of easy morals

indicators.note: you say means a word sounds like another

parts.note: a canon is a cleric living by a rule, close enough to a monk

explanation.surface: A lecherous monk is not to be trusted.
explanation.walkthrough: CANON is spoken like the gun word.
explanation.definitionFit: An unpredictable person who might do damage is someone not to rely on.

clue.text: Aaron Copland's first composition involves one instrument

indicators.note: involves means the rearranged letters wrap round another piece
composition means the letters are put together in a new order
first picks the opening letter of Copland's

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: Aaron Copland's earliest work features a single instrument.
explanation.walkthrough: 'composition' rearranges AARON plus C to OCARNA; 'involves' puts I inside.
explanation.definitionFit: An ocarina is a small wind instrument.

clue.text: Outlaw having to cheat in anything but poetry

indicators.note: in means the cheat word goes inside

parts.note: prose is writing that is not poetry
a crib is an illicit aid for cheating

explanation.surface: A banned person cheats in literature.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Outlaw' is a verb here.
explanation.definitionFit: To proscribe is to forbid or ban, so to outlaw.

clue.text: One paying bill for immigrant?

definitions.meaning: a person who comes to live in a new country

explanation.surface: An incomer pays the bill.
explanation.definitionFit: One who settles a bill and a colonist arriving in a new land share the word.

clue.text: Hangover resulting from heavy drinking

parts.note: read not as a headache but as a paunch that hangs over the belt after lots of ale

explanation.definitionFit: A belly swollen by drinking hangs over the waistband.

clue.text: Playing the jester is Jack's first and only card

indicators.note: first takes the opening letter of both Jack's and only

parts.note: a king is a playing card

explanation.surface: The fool is Jack's best card.
explanation.walkthrough: 'first' applies to both 'Jack's' and 'only', giving J and O.
explanation.definitionFit: Joking is behaving like a jester, making jests.

clue.text: Tubes carrying a river through French city to Italy

indicators.note: through means the a and river go inside the city

parts.note: Macon is a city in Burgundy
I is the international vehicle code for Italy

explanation.surface: Pasta carried through France to Italy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'carrying' and 'to' are link words.
explanation.definitionFit: Macaroni is pasta in short tubes.

clue.text: Tone down fit of rage

explanation.surface: Calm down someone's angry outburst.
explanation.definitionFit: To moderate is one sense of the word, and an angry tantrum is another.

clue.text: Perhaps beat up and down, up and down

indicators.text: up and down, up and down
indicators.note: says the word reads the same up and down, and also when turned upside down

parts.note: these definition words give the whole answer, and the answer is itself the palindrome: it reads the same from either end

explanation.surface: Beating something repeatedly.
explanation.walkthrough: The word reads the same either way and, in lower case, also upside down. A minim lasts two beats.
explanation.definitionFit: A minim is a note held for two beats, so loosely a beat, hence Perhaps.

clue.text: Someone beautiful in face, in parts

indicators.note: in means the beautiful person goes inside the face

parts.note: a dial is the face of a clock
a vision is a strikingly beautiful person

explanation.surface: A beauty is described by parts of her face.
explanation.definitionFit: Divisional means relating to divisions, organised in parts.

clue.text: Imminent knocking back of hard liquor

indicators.note: knocking back means the hard liquor words are read backwards

parts.note: H is the pencil abbreviation for hard
gin is a liquor

explanation.surface: Downing strong spirits is about to happen.
explanation.walkthrough: 'knocking back' looks like drinking but reverses H plus GIN.
explanation.definitionFit: Nigh means near, so close at hand or imminent.

clue.text: Blood bath, though horse protected?

annotationWithheld.why: Blood bath, though horse protected? (7): CAR(NAG)E needs 'protected' as both CARE and the container indicator, and 'though' gives nothing

clue.text: Gorilla seen with a crook?

definitions.meaning: an ape belongs to the highest order of mammals
an archbishop carries a crozier, a crook

explanation.surface: An ape is spotted with a criminal.
explanation.definitionFit: An ape is one of the highest mammals, and an archbishop holds the crook of office.
